why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Connect a wallet on the Arena of Faith site Open the Arena of Faith site and use its Connect Wallet or Login option.
2 Step 2 : Get Hero Cards with ACP Hero Cards are minted by spending ACP, and the site's menu has a Hero Card page under Miner Assets. Hero Skins are obtained the same way.
3 Step 3 : Play matches with your Hero Cards The site's menu offers a Game Download. Rewards for play with Hero Cards show up in the activity feed on the homepage .
5 Step 5 : Know the 14-day limit on a pledge You cannot take a pledged avatar back for 14 days, and the SVIP level applies from the moment of the pledge.
